verdict.rationale: Opting out of AI model training is a fair privacy question for a SaaS commerce platform that ships AI features, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a data-usage control, or any AI-training privacy policy. The cited items cover APIs, agents, MCP servers and commerce features only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
